quests.title: Clause & Predicate Guide
quests.subordinateClause: Although the morning traffic was exceptionally heavy,
quests.independentClause: our delivery van reached the warehouse on schedule.
quests.completeSentence: Although the morning traffic was exceptionally heavy, our delivery van reached the warehouse on schedule.
quests.coreRule: A subordinate clause introduced by "Although" must be balanced by an independent clause containing its own subject and finite verb.

contrastExample.incorrect: Although the morning traffic was exceptionally heavy.
contrastExample.whyBroken: Leaves a concessive condition without a main clause, creating a dangling sentence fragment.

breakdown.text: Although the morning traffic was exceptionally heavy,
breakdown.role: Establishes context, condition, or cause. Cannot stand alone.

breakdown.text: our delivery van reached the warehouse on schedule.
breakdown.role: Contains its own subject and finite verb. Completes the thought.

quests.independentClause: the experimental data yielded remarkably consistent results.

contrastExample.incorrect: Because the laboratory team calibrated the sensors precisely.
contrastExample.whyBroken: A causal conjunction demands an effect clause; isolated, it fails the independent clause test.
